objective: Define the metadata-invariant review boundary for generating a generic host-probe and coverage-output equivalence plan from tracked launch templates.

review_scope.name: template_metadata_invariants_for_verilator_like_hybrid_entry
review_scope.reason: Generated-config correctness breadth is now sufficient for the current branch. The next sharper risk is whether the template metadata required for Verilator-like hybrid operation is explicit and machine-checkable instead of being carried by per-target assumptions.

representative_templates.reason: Checks that legacy TL-UL templates still normalize into the generic host-probe and coverage-output plan.
Checks legacy TL-UL root clock/reset field handling.
Checks explicit primitive template metadata with package/include source ordering.
Checks non-default clock/reset names and reset polarity without adding a new NVDLA claim.
Checks full ITA/MHA style source, overlay, and coverage-output metadata.
Checks paged KV-cache serving-like template metadata without adding timing or workload claims.

required_metadata_invariants: template path is tracked by git
source_gate is present for explicit generated-config templates or legacy source evidence is traceable through the template and gate chain
top_module is present or derivable from the coverage testbench path
source_files are tracked and ordered for Verilator
verilator_args are explicit when include directories or warning policy are required
planned_overlay.coverage_tb_path is tracked or the legacy runner_args_template coverage_tb_path is tracked
planned_overlay.coverage_manifest_path is tracked or the legacy runner_args_template coverage_manifest_path is tracked
build.host_probe_builder is src/tools/build_host_probe.py for explicit templates or normalizes to that builder for legacy templates
build.host_probe.clock_field and build.host_probe.reset_field are explicit after normalization
build.host_probe.clock_report_name and build.host_probe.reset_report_name are explicit after normalization
build.host_probe.reset_asserted_value and reset_deasserted_value are explicit after normalization
build.host_probe.host_clock_control and host_reset_control are explicit after normalization
build.host_probe.probe_syms_state is explicit after normalization when syms-state probing is required or intentionally disabled
dry-run output uses python3 src/tools/build_host_probe.py and does not require a Makefile host-probe target
dry-run output includes --coverage-output-gate and --coverage-output-target for explicit compare plans
--coverage-output-target matches the expected target basename for the coverage manifest
reports and artifacts remain generated evidence only

required_next_gate.name: run_tlul_template_schema_metadata_invariant_review_dry_run_gate
must_record: no dry-run plan requires make -C src/hybrid for a target-specific host-probe
all explicit compare plans include coverage-output gate and target arguments
any legacy-normalized clock/reset metadata differences are explicitly reported

non_claims: not proof that every future template passes build/run/compare
not universal validation for every historical template
not a runtime or ABI change
